dashboard.title: Welcome to DollarSeeds
dashboard.body: Go here to see your current income, what's left to spend, and how much money you have for each spending category

transactions.title: Add Your Income and Expenses
transactions.body: Enter an amount, pick a category, name it, choose a date, and save. New income is automatically split across all categories

goals.title: Track Your Goals
goals.body: Create a personal or debt goal. Add money to it from this month's income, or from your General Savings (GS).
goals.subnote: Add to GS whenever you have no specific saving goal. Money not spent will roll over into your GS at the end of the month

lessons.title: Grow in wisdom
lessons.body: Scripture-rooted video series on money, generosity, and stewardship, given by successful professionals.
lessons.subnote: More series will be added as the app and its reach grows

startingBalance.title: Your starting balance
startingBalance.body: DollarSeeds tracks your money month by month. Enter the savings you had BEFORE {{month}} — everything you'd already put away.
startingBalance.note: Don't include any {{month}} income or expenses. You'll log those normally in the Transactions tab.
startingBalance.confirmBody: This becomes your General Savings balance. You can add to it or move it into a goal any time.

error.timeout: That's taking too long. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Couldn't save your starting balance. Please try again.
